# virtual location type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:virtualLocationType`](gmeow-virtualLocationType.md)

The kind(s) of a virtual location (one or more [`gmeow:VirtualLocationType`](../classes/gmeow-VirtualLocationType.md) individuals). Non-functional: multi-source classifications may differ and must coexist as evidence ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to classify a virtual location by one or more [`gmeow:VirtualLocationType`](../classes/gmeow-VirtualLocationType.md) values; non-functional, so multi-source classifications coexist.

### Avoid when

- Avoid encoding the kind as a [`VirtualLocation`](../classes/gmeow-VirtualLocation.md) subclass ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Attach one or more [`gmeow:VirtualLocationType`](../classes/gmeow-VirtualLocationType.md) individuals; competing classifications coexist as evidence.
